AFRICA_DAY: (In celebrating 25th Africa Day, this Pi Pioneers Training Application is launched)
INTRO_P1: Pi Network is a global digital currency and ecosystem project designed to make cryptocurrency accessible and useful to everyday people.
INTRO_P2: Unlike traditional cryptocurrencies that often require expensive mining machines and high electricity consumption, Pi Network allows ordinary people to participate directly from their mobile phones.
INTRO_P3: The vision of Pi Network is to build a people-powered ecosystem where digital currency can be used for real utility, real services, real communities and real economic participation.
GLOBAL_MISSION: The Global Mission of Pi Network
WHY_P1: Many cryptocurrencies mainly focus on speculation and trading on exchanges. Pi Network focuses more on ecosystem participation, utility creation, merchant adoption and community-driven growth.
WHY_P2: The long-term strength of any currency comes from people using it practically in daily life.
BUILD_P1: Africa has an opportunity to become one of the strongest utility-driven regions within the Pi Ecosystem through education, merchant adoption, community participation and practical ecosystem development.
CH1_SUB: Welcome to the Africa Pioneers Education Hub - External. This platform was created to educate, empower and prepare African pioneers and businesses for practical participation in the Pi Ecosystem.
